content.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell clairvoyance} spell. An eyeball bobs in this yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.

content.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Clairvoyance|SRD52} spell (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
An eyeball bobs in this potion's yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.
